steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Operator Suzuran...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yo, Aosta! We're back!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Get out.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh?! I'm so sorry to bother you, I'll leave you alone right now...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Not you. I mean this noisy son of a mother.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: He'll run his mouth with all sorts of things you just shouldn't be hearing, so we stop him before he gets the chance.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, what, is that how you figure me? I was just pumped to bring Little Miss Suzuran to you here, see, she said she wanted you to make some cursed doll for Christmas...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: A 'Specter doll.'

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yeah, get it? That's gonna be real simple, right, Aosta? Needling that stuff's your number one thing.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: She was looking for our room for a while, y'know. Just throw that together and give it to her, yeah?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: It's not that simple, you single-celled organism.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I'm sorry to have disturbed you...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Whatever. It's not like I'm turning you right down.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So, what exactly is it you want me to make?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I actually saw your name in the list of custom Christmas present makers. I was hoping you could help make a doll for a 'Christmas Party' gift exchange.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: A gift exchange, huh.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes! We all pulled lots to decide our recipients.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I drew Operator Specter, so I thought of making a nice, ordinary 'Specter' doll to match their personality.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Whoaaa, that's easy as hell! Aosta, c'mon, who put a stick up your ass? Quit scrunching your face up, what's not to get about this?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...Is that all, Suzuran?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes! I can pay for you and your materials out of my own pocket!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Then you know the rules, don't you?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Tense) I-I understand!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Huh? What's the big deal now? Why so nervous, Suzurina?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I take orders based on mood.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: My commission sheet noted 'I only accept one order per Christmas' on the back.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: *Clicks tongue* You're like one of those 'scumbag grown-up' types from the movies. What's your terms and conditions like? If it sounds too hard, you're just not gonna?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Any tailored product is easy enough, as far as I'm concerned. If it doesn't require any special Originium processing or materials, I can get it done in a trivial amount of time.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So... Suzuran, about your request...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Gwuh...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: —I accept it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Th-That's great!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: (Your rule's just accepting the first guy who comes your way with an order, I bet.)

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: (Hmph.)

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Cool, everything's sorted! Now—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I'm not finished. The question we have to answer now is the 'plan' itself.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Plan? What else do you even need? Just follow what Suzurina asked for and make something, and you'll be fine.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: *sigh*... Chiave, you should get into carrying a mirror. See how stupid you look playing the clown.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Who asked you to ramble so much? I don't understand why you brainy guys always talk like you're covering up. Where the hell's the problem?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Let me make this clear: I'm not being intentionally difficult.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Suzuran, you're sure you want me to make you a doll for Operator Specter, as a gift?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: In that case, your design?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: A rough sort of hand sketch works, a detailed written description works, or the most direct path, a photo of this Operator 'Specter.' You haven't given me anything, have you?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: ...Uh... um... I haven't.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Huh? So you mean...?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, you dumbass. That's what I'm saying. Approach everything with a little more thought, and you'll find your problem faster, no matter in normal life or during critical moments.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: This 'Christmas gift exchange' doesn't interest us, so we haven't kept on top of it.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: But Suzuran, you wouldn't know which participant you're gifting to beforehand either.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The problem is, whether me or Chiave, we've never even heard of anything this Operator 'Specter' has done before.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: We haven't seen them in the cafeteria, the gym, or on any sort of mission, either.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You've got a keen eye though. Any doll you have me make will blow any pile of pretty handmade gifts out of the water.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Right now, the most important piece of information we're missing is—just who is your recipient, this Operator called Specter? What do they look like?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha, c'mon, Little Miss, don't get bummed out. Aosta just talks kind of direct, that's all. He's not saying he's gonna refuse your request.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: More likely if you try to find anyone else to make your present, he'll bring his 'weapons' out and go fight the other tailor for supremacy, then come back and cross his heart to get what you asked done.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I'm sorry, Chiave, it's my fault for rushing too fast to call on you, when I clearly don't know enough yet about who I'm even giving this gift to.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I gotta say, it's a pretty weird game when someone you know nothing about's signed up.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hehe. That must be a large part of the reason this game exists. It encourages everyone to know each other better.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But actually, I assumed I was the only one in the dark on Operator 'Specter.' I never thought nobody else knew...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Damn, that's weird! Don't be shocked, but I don't think I can help you out with this!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, but it works out this way too. You work hard, go around asking everyone about 'Specter,' and you know all sorts of people better by the end of it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: —Just so long as it's not someone you should be steering clear of.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: The people taking part in this thing can't be that dangerous, right?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-I don't think so.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ha ha, thought so too. Sounds like an average party game to me.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Go ask and see, then, Suzuran!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Rhodes Island is so full of mystery guys, you have no idea. You don't know if they're just like the name, mysterious like a 'specter,' terrifying to see, voice deep and dark all around you at night...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Eek...!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: E-Even so, they're my recipient, so I'll try my hardest... to give them this present!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yeah, I like that attitude.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Careful out there, Suzuran. You land in any hot water, just give me or Aosta a shout—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If there's one thing we know, it's problem-busting.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hm... I need to think, what should I do now...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Chiave and Aosta's worries aren't unreasonable. After all, I've never heard anything about Operator 'Specter' before, and I haven't ever seen them either...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But Ifrit invited me to do this, and Silence helped set it up. There shouldn't be anyone to watch out for.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But because I don't recognize them, I don't know who I can ask, either...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mgh... I can't be pessimistic! No matter who they are, I joined in so I could share the holiday cheer, and experience the effort that goes into getting gifts, and the nice surprise of receiving them.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I'm looking forward to being part of all sorts of holidays, and getting all sorts of gifts... and they must be looking forward to it with great care, too.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I can find information for sure. Everyone is always praising the dolls Aosta makes. I have to do my best too, to give them a gift that'll make them happy.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Alright. Let's work on finding any relevant information about Operator Specter today.
Half an hour later...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: E... Excuse me...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Um... May I ask...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Hm? If it isn't Suzuran. What's...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Calm down, I'll hear out what you want to say. What's happened?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (Suzuran doesn't usually look so frazzled... Could something serious have happened?)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-I want to... find someone... Meteorite, do you know Operator 'Specter?'

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Specter... is it...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Because... Because I asked some friends, and nobody knows of any 'Specter' at all, so I thought I might've come across... something strange.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Phew... So that's how it is.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It's alright, don't be scared. Good girl. You haven't run into anything too bad just yet.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It's true, 'Specter' is a very exclusively kept secret, but she's one among Rhodes Island's personnel as well.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: True indeed... I don't believe she and any of your friends would've ever come across each other.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: But you have to tell me, why are you seeking information on her?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-I wanted to give her a present...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Present? But you hardly even knew she existed.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Ah, let me think... It was the one on the pamphlet, the Christmas party with the gift exchange of some sort. Is that what led you to look for her?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes! Could it be... you're in the exchange too?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I am. We're both getting presents ready right now. Alright—there's no need for alarm, then. I may know a few things or other regarding this operator.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But why are you the only one who knows anything about Specter so far?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I've been searching so hard...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: You're very diligent, Suzuran.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: But here at Rhodes Island, there are more than a few people who have to hide themselves.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I only know of Specter because we once fought alongside each other.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But you're always on such difficult, dangerous missions...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Though it's a reluctant thing, to Rhodes Island, people like me who can 'cut through to the chase' are indispensable.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It's easier on myself, as well. After all, going on safe, secure work would've actually dulled me.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: That said, as a 'chase-cutter,' Specter is certainly much sharper than I am.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Do you know... what kind of person Specter is?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: We only worked together once.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: She's a young woman from the deep sea. A presence whose mind is a bit of a challenge to comprehend for the rest of us.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Unable to carry out tactical communication. She takes up her weapon, hears an order, and then heed only that sole commander's orders until the mission is over and done with.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Is Specter... a very quiet person?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: If you call not uttering a single word 'quiet.'

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: But silence is far from just an affectation, it is also a choice.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: When she sees terrifying, murderous enemies before us, and monsters who roar as they charge us, she preserves that 'quiet' way of hers unbroken, with her mood completely unreadable.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: After that... she wreaks her most unwavering destruction, as if from start to end she believes that she, on her own, is facing off against every single threat.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I imagine that, aside from listening to her commander's orders, she gives not one care for her own body.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Whether enemy or ally, alive or dead, she sees none of the emotional fluctuation between anything or anyone in her surroundings.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Yet, I wonder if her wordless self is ultimately aware of how she 'holds her peace,' and whether she hopes to communicate with others.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Th... Then, setting battle aside, would Specter have any relation to anyone else?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Now that's a difficult question... but, and I imagine, Specter's psychological state is far from suited to a normal life.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: At the very least... I can't picture her dwelling ordinarily in the dormitories.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Then that means... maybe the Medical team has more...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ah! I get it.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Uh-huh. Now, I absolutely didn't just mention any significance-bearing clue.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hehe, thank you, Meteorite. If we get another chance, I'd like to hear you share more of your war stories.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If conflict is unavoidable, if our only option to protect them is to fight... I hope I can protect the friends and family I hold dear too.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Hm? You want more war stories...? I'd need to spend some time to prepare for that.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: But, if I were to guess, it'd be very difficult for me to ever cooperate with Specter on another mission.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: After we left the mission zone, and until we were back at Rhodes Island to recuperate, the sight of her weightlessly, methodically tearing our enemies to shreds played back in my mind.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Her mind could only be barren, or else hold secrets dangerous enough to outweigh those atrocities.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Otherwise, how could she be so indifferent to the result of what she does with her own hands?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right—come in.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sorry to bother you—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Huh? Here at my clinic of your own accord, Suzuran? You wanted the same no-holds-barred health checkup as always, then?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No! Nothing that scary, Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just messing with you. I'm on break right now; if you want to play something with me, I'm all ears.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So. What's on your mind?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Actually, I'm preparing a Christmas present for a gift exchange.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mmhm, mmhm.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: And also, my partner for the exchange is Specter.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mmhm... mm? Did you say Specter?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wait, she shouldn't have left the med bay recently. How could she...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ah... so you do know something about Specter.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That's brilliant. I was afraid I figured it wrong.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-I'm giving Specter a handmade memento doll, so I want to know some things about her.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Info about Specter... huh.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I can confirm I've assisted Dr. Kal'tsit in treating her before.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But her mental state has been overly unstable as of recent. A while's already passed without her leaving her treatment room.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Did she really sign up to a gift exchange?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-I think anyone has the right to enter it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But Meteorite said that Specter wouldn't take part in a game like this, too. Maybe... maybe somebody helped her sign up?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But no matter what, I'm not going to mess this up!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's for sure. You're a goody-two-shoes, Suzuran.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: By my guess, there's only the ones who visit her that... ahem, no, forget it, nothing.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Is Specter very ill, and unable to leave?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: During her very few moments of lucidity, Specter might choose to head outside for a bit.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But her language systems have been greatly affected, and rather than saying anything someone might misconstrue, she chooses to be silent most of the time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hm... on the battlefield, she displays calm behavior exhibited through past muscle memory, and after her fill of combat, her period of over-fatigue allows her to soundly rest.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So don't worry too much. Specter leads her lifestyle in the manners she's able to choose.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If that's true, I want to see her...!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: So I can't, after all...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even I can't enter from her room at will, most of the time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I understand you want to give your gift to her in person, but given Specter's current condition, that may be extremely difficult.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But I just hope... even if I can't meet her, I can at least finish this present, and have it reach her hands.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I think there's a lot of meaning in giving and receiving gifts!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's really, really great. Good on you, Suzuran. Make sure you hold onto that kind heart!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whisper) Actually, as long as the info's not too sensitive, it's not like I can't make an exception for you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hehe. Who made me Kal'tsit's trusted disciple?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Thank you, Folinic...! If it's okay, I want to gather any design elements I can use to make the souvenir Specter doll...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Yoohoo!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well now, if it isn't little Suzuran?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Is Specter your topic of the day?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ah, Dr. Warfarin.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Damn, it's her. Here we go...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Just overheard while I was passing by the door, that is all. You want to make a doll of Specter, do you?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Now isn't that such a cute notion! I'll help!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even that couldn't escape your eavesdropping, Dr. Warfarin.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Honestly, I could give you her measurements: bust, waist, AND hips. Plus the precise material used in her clothes... my access far outstrips Dr. Folinic's here.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Y-You really know all those details...?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: More than that, I could also help get your doll into Specter's hands.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Of course, my price... heh, heh, you peddling Penguin Logistician, I'll have that commemorative run of tomato juice out of your mitts yet...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I-I understand, I'll go right now and ask—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Don't make lackeys out of children, Dr. Warfarin!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Ah, Suzuran! You don't need to go right now—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Good, then! Our business is thus concluded!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Huh? What... do you mean?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Wasn't that a very dangerous spot you were just in? I don't think allowing Suzuran to know the present truth of things vis-a-vis Specter is any good idea.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She cares, that's all. She's a smart girl, and knows there are many things she shouldn't come to understand, nor need to be aware of.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Just a little curiosity can put one in an irreversibly sticky situation. It's a very well-worn warning.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Even so, I wonder what warm heart thought to offer Specter a little extra kindness—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I imagine they set Suzuran up to give the gift as well.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Quite. After all, anyone else raising Specter topics with no warning would raise some very clear-cut red flags.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And only Suzuran could make us, or anyone, believe this was genuine passion and concern.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Specter wouldn't be familiar with this, the holiday gift exchange... and has no way of preparing in time.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Do you feel sorry for Suzuran?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm just...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: To be clear, I didn't say what I just said for the fun of it.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Come the time, I'll have Suzuran give the sewn-up present over to me, and I'll think of some way to have Specter receive it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But if we allow Dr. Kal'tsit to find out about this—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Didn't you just say? For Suzuran's sake, you wouldn't balk at using a little 'tiny bit of prerogative.'

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: To be factual, it's for Specter's sake as well.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: How will she respond when she receives this gift...? That should have some experimental value, no?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But still... I have this feeling, the one apologizing to Dr. Kal'tsit in the end's going to be me!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Well, it certainly won't be me—
Twenty days later...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mmn...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Yawn—)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It's already morning. My coat... phew, alright!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Today I need to go to Folinic's for a health checkup, I need to find Kal'tsit for tutoring... ah, and there's a tea party and a tailoring expert giving lessons this afternoon. I need to keep my spirits up all day.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If I start learning how to sew in earnest now, maybe one day I could become just like Aosta, able to make presents everyone will love.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hehe. I've already given Dr. Warfarin the doll I asked him to make so she could pass it on to Specter for Christmas.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin said Specter probably doesn't know who signed her up to the gift exchange, but when she got her present, her state seemed to improve a bit.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ah, Christmas was already six days ago... it was so much fun, I'm still giddy even now.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I hope Specter got to enjoy some Christmasy feeling too.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: After she gets better, I wonder if we'll have the chance to chat, and eat together, hehe...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Alright, I need my schoolbag, schoolbag...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: What's this gift box on the table...? This wasn't here last night, was it?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: C-Could it be there were too many people to give gifts to, and Father Christmas missed a gift by mistake—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Wow.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: 'A present from the abyssal deep sea'...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It's a music box!
